BorrowingDeadlineService
UC12 Process Borrowing Deadlines (Task 1.6: auto-return; Task 1.8: due-date reminders): as time passes, buyers are reminded that a borrowed item is nearly due, and items whose borrowing period has ended are returned automatically.
BorrowingDeadlineTimer
The Timer actor of UC12 Process Borrowing Deadlines: it signals, again and again, that it is time to check the borrowing deadlines (UC12 step 1).
BorrowRequest
A request to borrow a lend listing for a period (BorrowRequest in the domain class diagram).
BrowseQuery
What the buyer asked Browse Marketplace to show (UC8 step 3): a keyword, the filters and a sort order.
BrowseService
UC8 Browse Marketplace, for the Buyer (Tasks 1.3 and 1.4): searching, filtering and sorting the live listings, opening a listing's detail, and viewing the seller's profile and reviews.
BrowseText
The wording of the Browse Marketplace screen (UC8), kept apart from the JavaFX code so it can be unit-tested.
BrowseView
The Browse Marketplace screen (UC8 steps 1-5; Task 1.3): the live listings as cards, with a keyword search, filters for category, listing type, condition and price range, and a sort order.
Buyer
A student or staff member using the buyer portal (Task 1).
BuyerDashboardController
The buyer's dashboard: the sidebar, and the main area that shows one screen at a time.
BuyerLoginController
 
BuyerRegisterController
 
Category
Predefined item categories (Category in the domain class diagram; Task 2.3).
ChatEntry
One line in a chat's history (UC6 step 2): a free-text message, or a price offer, borrow request or claim the buyer made on the listing, which appears in the history alongside the messages (UC6 Special Requirement 3).
ChatList
The chat screen, the same in the buyer and seller portals (UC6 Chat About Listing; Tasks 1.5 and 2.5): every chat of the logged-in user in a list, the one with the newest message or offer first, and the chosen chat (ChatView) beside the list, as in a desktop messenger, with a light grey line between them.
ChatService
UC6 Chat About Listing, shared by the Buyer and the Seller (Tasks 1.5 and 2.5): the private chat between one buyer and the seller of one listing.
ChatText
The wording of the shared chat screens (ChatView, ChatList), kept apart from the JavaFX code so it can be unit-tested.
ChatThread
The private chat between one buyer and the seller of one listing (ChatThread in the domain class diagram; UC6).
ChatView
The chat screen, the same in the buyer and seller portals (UC6 Chat About Listing; Tasks 1.5 and 2.5): the history of messages and offers with sender and time, a box to write a message, and a search of the history that jumps to the chosen message and highlights it.
ChatView.AgreeToCounter
What the buyer's Agree to Counter does with the countered offer they chose: Make Offer with the counter's terms filled in (UC5 step 1 and Special Requirement 4).
ChatView.RespondToOffers
What the seller's Respond in Offers & Requests does: the seller portal shows its Manage Offers & Requests screen with these offers marked (Scrolling.JUMP_HIGHLIGHT) and the newest one scrolled into view (Scrolling.bringIntoView(javafx.scene.control.ScrollPane, javafx.scene.Node)), as a chat search result is (UC6 A2 step 4).
Choices
Filter choices of the form "All categories" followed by the values of an enum, as the buyer's Browse Marketplace (UC8 step 3) and Deal History (UC11 step 3) screens use them.
Claim
A claim on a giveaway listing.
ContentHost
Somewhere a screen can be shown: each portal's dashboard, whose main area shows one screen at a time.
Conversation
The chat between one buyer and the seller of one listing, as one of them sees it (UC6 step 2): the listing, the two people, and the history in the order it was sent.
CreateListingService
Task 2.3 Create New Listing, shared by the seller form and the admin's "add a listing for a seller" (Task 3.7, once it is wired).
DataCipher
Encrypts saved files so they are never stored as readable plain text (the data and every listing's information must be "securely stored").
DataStore
The single store for every user, listing, offer, chat thread, review, report, notification and admin record (Technical Requirement: data structures for users, listings, offers, chats, ratings and notifications).
DeadlineReport
What one run of Process Borrowing Deadlines (UC12) did.
Deal
One of the buyer's deals as My Deals shows it (UC7 step 2): the price offer, borrow request or claim, its listing and seller, and what the buyer can do with it right now.
DealDetails
Everything the admin sees for VIEW DETAILS on one deal (Task 3.5, step 4.1).
DealFilter
The filter options of the All Deals Record (Task 3.5, step 2).
DealHistoryService
UC11 View Deal History, for the Buyer (Task 1.9): every completed deal of the buyer, newest deal date first, narrowed down by a date range, a category and part of the seller's name.
DealHistoryView
The Deal History screen (UC11 View Deal History; Task 1.9): every completed deal of the buyer, newest deal date first, with its item title, seller, deal date, deal type and outcome (step 2), and a date range, a category and a seller's name to narrow it down (step 3).
DealNotReviewableException
The deal cannot be reviewed (UC10 A1): it is not one of the buyer's deals, it is not completed, or it has been reviewed already (Special Requirement 1).
DealRecord
One row of the All Deals Record table (Task 3.5, step 3), already worked out by the service.
DealRules
The deal lifecycle that all three portals share: what happens to a listing, its other offers and the people involved when a deal is accepted, completed or returned, or when a listing's open offers must be declined.
DealState
The state of a deal on the All Deals Record screen (Task 3.5).
DealText
The wording of the My Deals screen (UC7), kept apart from the JavaFX code so it can be unit-tested.
DeletedAccount
What DataStore.deleteAccount(java.lang.String) deleted and cancelled.
Dialogs
The dialogs every portal uses, so confirmations, messages and errors look and behave the same everywhere (non-functional requirement: consistent interaction across the three portals).
EncryptedJsonStorage
Saves the data as JSON, encrypted with DataCipher, in one file; deleted-account snapshots and listing photos go to encrypted files of their own, in folders next to it:
Formats
One way to show dates, prices, ratings and periods on every screen, so all three portals look and read the same (non-functional requirement: a consistent interface).
GiveawayListing
A listing given away for free (GiveawayListing in the domain class diagram).
HistoryEntry
One completed deal as Deal History shows it (UC11 step 2): the deal, its listing and the seller's name.
HistoryQuery
What the buyer chose on Deal History (UC11 step 3): a date range, a category and part of a seller's name.
HistoryText
The wording of the Deal History screen (UC11), kept apart from the JavaFX code so it can be unit-tested.
InvalidDateRangeException
The date range starts after it ends (UC11 A2).
ItemCondition
Condition of a listed item (ItemCondition in the domain class diagram; Task 2.3).
LendListing
A listing lent out for a period (LendListing in the domain class diagram).
Listing
An item a seller posts (Listing in the domain class diagram).
ListingAction
Actions an admin can take on a listing (ListingAction in the domain class diagram).
ListingActionRecord
A record of one action an admin took on a listing (ListingActionRecord in the domain class diagram).
ListingCard
The listing card, the same in all three portals (non-functional requirement: shared components for cards).
ListingDetail
What the listing detail screen shows (UC8 step 7; Task 1.4), as it was when the buyer opened the listing: the listing with all its fields and photos, whether it is available, and its seller with the average rating and reviews.
ListingDetails
Everything the admin sees when viewing one listing (Manage Marketplace Listings 3.7): the listing, its seller's full name, and the reports filed on it.
ListingDetailView
The listing detail screen (UC8 step 7; Task 1.4): all photos, all the listing's fields, the full description, the seller's name with average rating and reviews, the availability status, and three buttons: the action for the listing type (disabled when the listing is not available), Chat with Seller and Report Listing.
ListingFilter
The filter options of the admin's listing list (Manage Marketplace Listings, step 2).
ListingNotReportableException
The listing cannot be reported: the buyer has reported it already (UC9 A1, Special Requirement 3), or can no longer open it, so the use case's precondition no longer holds.
ListingOverview
The top of a listing's detail screen, the same in every portal: all photos, the title with the status badge and the price, every field, and the full description (UC8 step 7; the admin's "full listing details", Manage Marketplace Listings 5.1).
ListingSort
The sort orders of Browse Marketplace (UC8 step 3; Task 1.3).
ListingStatus
Lifecycle status of a listing (ListingStatus in the domain class diagram).
ListingSummary
What a listing card shows, worked out once from a listing and the store.
ListingSummary.Field
One named value on the listing detail screen, such as "Condition" and "Used".
ListingType
The three kinds of listing (Task 2.3).
ListingUnavailableException
The listing no longer accepts an offer, borrow request or claim (UC5 A1): it was reserved, lent, sold, given or removed, another buyer's claim on it is pending, or its seller was deactivated.
LiveUpdates
Tells the open dashboard that the data changed without the user doing anything, so the screen it shows can reload.
LoginResult
Outcome of AuthService.login(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.hkust.marketplace.models.UserRole).
MarketplaceApp
HKUST Marketplace - Main Application Entry Point

Predefined HKUST meet-up locations (MeetupLocation in the domain class diagram).
Message
One free-text message in a chat thread (Message in the domain class diagram).

The My Deals screen (UC7; Task 1.6): the buyer's current deals, followed by the completed ones.

Offer
A buyer's action on a listing (Offer in the domain class diagram), called a "deal" in the use cases.
OfferAction
What each party can do with an offer now (assumptions register 71): the seller answers it on Manage Offers & Requests (3.3-3.5; Task 2.5), the only place where offers are answered: a Pending offer can be accepted, declined or countered, except that a claim cannot be countered; a Countered offer, waiting for the buyer, can still be declined.
OfferForm
What the Make Offer form starts with (UC5 steps 2-4), after the listing was found to be available.

Status of a price offer, borrow request or claim (OfferStatus in the domain class diagram).

How a price offer, borrow request or claim reads on every screen that shows one: the chat history (UC6), My Deals (UC7), the seller's offers and the admin's deal records.
PasswordHasher
Hashes and verifies passwords so they are never stored in plaintext (UC1 Special Requirement 1, UC2 Special Requirement 1).
PhotoFrame
A frame of a fixed size that shows one listing photo, the same everywhere a photo appears: the thumbnail on a listing card (Task 1.3), the photos on the listing detail screen (Task 1.4) and in the admin's review (Task 3.2).

Adds listing photos (Create Listings step 8 and the admin's Manage Marketplace Listings: up to Listing.MAX_PHOTOS photos per listing).
PriceOffer
A price offer on a sale listing (PriceOffer in the domain class diagram).

RatingSummary

A screen that can reload its data while it is open, for example after the borrowing-deadline timer returned an item (UC12 step 4: the change shows on the open My Deals screen).
Report

ReportForm

Where to scroll is worked out in Scrolling.position(double, double, double, double), apart from JavaFX, so it is unit-tested.
